result.instructions: Tools for Lingohub, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the localization projects my LingoHub key can access."; "Which locales still need translations in this project?"; "List the resource files in this localization project.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Lingohub data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run lingohub_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lingohub_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lingohub_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. lingohub_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: lingohub_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List every Lingohub project this API key can see (owned and shared, across workspaces). Each entry has the title, its links and the workspace_url + project_url slugs that every other tool needs. GET /v1/projects.

tools.name: lingohub_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: One project: title, description, owner email, configured locales (project_locales), timestamps and links. GET /v1/{workspace_url}/projects/{project_url}.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

project_url.description: Project URL slug (e.g. "feature-demo"); list_projects returns it as project_url.

tools.name: lingohub_get_project_status
tools.title: Get project file status
tools.description: Translation status of one project: each resource file with per-locale segment counts (NOT_TRANSLATED, DRAFT, TRANSLATED, APPROVED, ...), failing quality checks, the export formats it supports and whether a Git repository is connected and can be pushed to. GET .../projects/{project_url}/status.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

project_url.description: Project URL slug (e.g. "feature-demo"); list_projects returns it as project_url.

branch.description: Project branch name. Default: the project's default branch. An unknown branch is HTTP 422.

tools.name: lingohub_get_workspace_status
tools.title: Get workspace translation status
tools.description: Translation progress of every project in one workspace: title, app URL, total segment count and per-locale counts by status (NOT_TRANSLATED, DRAFT, TRANSLATED, PREFILLED, APPROVED). GET /v1/{workspace_url}/projects/status.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

tools.name: lingohub_create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: WRITE: create a new localization project in a workspace (needs settings-management permission on the key). Returns the new project with its links. It adds a project and changes nothing existing; repeating the call can create a second project. POST /v1/{workspace_url}/projects.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

resource_type.description: Resource file type, which fixes the import/export format (e.g. standard_json, i18next_json, android_xml, ios_strings, gettext_po, xliff).

source_language.description: Source language code, e.g. en or en-GB.

tools.name: lingohub_list_resources
tools.title: List resource files
tools.description: List a project's resource files: name, locale and links (including a download link). GET .../projects/{project_url}/resources.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

project_url.description: Project URL slug (e.g. "feature-demo"); list_projects returns it as project_url.

locale_in_file_name.description: Whether file names carry the locale: ALL (default), TARGETS or NONE.

add_iso2_slug.description: Always add the iso2_slug parameter to the rendered file URLs.

branch.description: Project branch name. Default: the project's default branch. An unknown branch is HTTP 422.

tools.name: lingohub_download_resource
tools.title: Download resource file
tools.description: Download one resource file as text, in one language. file_name is the file name as list_resources shows it (the folder goes in `path`). Long files are cut at 40000 characters (truncated: true); use request_export for a full copy. GET .../projects/{project_url}/resources/{file_name}.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

project_url.description: Project URL slug (e.g. "feature-demo"); list_projects returns it as project_url.

path.description: Folder of the file, when the file name alone is not unique.

language.description: Locale code to export (overrides the locale in the file name), e.g. de.

branch.description: Project branch name. Default: the project's default branch. An unknown branch is HTTP 422.

blank_content_handling.description: What to export for a segment with no translation in the target language.

filter_by_status.description: Only export target segments in this state.

html_encoding.description: How HTML in a segment is escaped.

tools.name: lingohub_upload_resource_file
tools.title: Upload resource file
tools.description: WRITE: upload one text resource file (JSON, properties, XLIFF, PO, ...) into a project. The language comes from the file name or from `language`. The import flags decide whether existing segments are changed or deactivated: with updating or deactivation on, translations already in Lingohub can be overwritten or switched off, so state the flags you want. Never retried. POST .../projects/{project_url}/resources.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

project_url.description: Project URL slug (e.g. "feature-demo"); list_projects returns it as project_url.

file_name.description: File name with extension, e.g. en.json.

content.description: The file text (UTF-8), up to 1000000 characters.

path.description: Folder the file is uploaded to; set it when the file name collides with another file (HTTP 406).

language.description: Locale of this file (overrides the locale in the file name), e.g. de.

branch.description: Project branch name. Default: the project's default branch. An unknown branch is HTTP 422.

source_create_new.description: If this is a source-language file: create new segments.

source_update_existing.description: If this is a source-language file: update changed segments.

source_deactivate_missing.description: If this is a source-language file: deactivate segments missing from the file.

target_create_new.description: If this is a target-language file: create new segments.

target_update_existing.description: If this is a target-language file: update changed translations (overwrites existing ones).

target_deactivate_missing.description: If this is a target-language file: deactivate segments missing from the file.

tools.name: lingohub_delete_resource
tools.title: Delete resource file
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE: delete a resource container: the source-language file AND all its target-language files with their translations. file_name and path must address the source-language file. This cannot be undone through the API. Never retried. DELETE .../projects/{project_url}/resources/{file_name}.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

project_url.description: Project URL slug (e.g. "feature-demo"); list_projects returns it as project_url.

file_name.description: File name of the SOURCE-language file, as list_resources shows it.

branch.description: Project branch name. Default: the project's default branch. An unknown branch is HTTP 422.

tools.name: lingohub_request_export
tools.title: Request export
tools.description: Start an asynchronous export of a project's resource files as a ZIP. It creates an export job and changes no project data. Returns the export id; poll get_export until its status is SUCCESS to get the download URL. Without filters it exports every file and language. POST .../projects/{project_url}/exports.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

project_url.description: Project URL slug (e.g. "feature-demo"); list_projects returns it as project_url.

file_paths.description: Only these files, with the locale placeholder as shown in Lingohub, e.g. config/locales/%{locale}/messages.yml.

export_format.description: Override the export format of the project type.

branch.description: Project branch name. Default: the project's default branch. An unknown branch is HTTP 422.

tools.name: lingohub_get_export
tools.title: Get export status
tools.description: Status of an export started with request_export: overall and per-file status (NEW, SCHEDULED, PROCESSING, SUCCESS, SKIPPED, ERROR), error details and, when done, the pre-signed download URL of the ZIP. GET .../projects/{project_url}/exports/{export_id}.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

project_url.description: Project URL slug (e.g. "feature-demo"); list_projects returns it as project_url.

export_id.description: Export id from request_export, e.g. reg_18USq6822XIv-19847171.

tools.name: lingohub_list_context_images
tools.title: List context images
tools.description: List the context images (screenshots that show translators where a text is used) of a project, with connected-segment counts and processing status. Paginated; page is zero-based. GET .../projects/{project_url}/contextImages.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

project_url.description: Project URL slug (e.g. "feature-demo"); list_projects returns it as project_url.

tools.name: lingohub_delete_context_image
tools.title: Delete context image
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE: delete one context image and its connections to text segments. Never retried. DELETE .../projects/{project_url}/contextImages/{image_id}.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

project_url.description: Project URL slug (e.g. "feature-demo"); list_projects returns it as project_url.

image_id.description: Context image id from list_context_images, e.g. ci_18USq6822XIv-19847171.

tools.name: lingohub_push_to_repository
tools.title: Push translations to repository
tools.description: WRITE: push the project's resource files to its linked Git repository (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket or Azure DevOps; the connection must already exist). Depending on push_type this commits to a branch or opens a pull request, so it changes the user's repository. Never retried. POST .../projects/{project_url}/push.

workspace_url.description: Workspace URL slug (e.g. "lingohub-demo"); list_projects returns it as workspace_url.

project_url.description: Project URL slug (e.g. "feature-demo"); list_projects returns it as project_url.

push_type.description: PUSH commits directly; PULL_REQUEST opens a pull/merge request. Default: the connection's setting.

branch.description: Branch to push to. Default: the repository connection's default branch.

path.description: Only push resource files under this path.

pull_request_branch.description: Branch to create for the pull request (PULL_REQUEST only).
